method: the blend must build: one closed solid whose face count is the loft's 3 plus the blend's 1. A round or chamfer of a ruled spline wall has no closed-form volume, so the volume is not graded
what: the same loft between two fit-point spline sections (radius 15 and 20); the rim of the larger end chamfered 2 must give one closed solid of 4 faces
